predicate.label: location of organization or its office
predicate.definition: Geographic place X hosts the physical location, base, or office of organization Y.
includes: explicit organization location, headquarters, office, or base in X
a geographically identified office or division of Y located in X
excludes: X is a corporate subsidiary or parent rather than a geographic place
national affiliation alone without physical location
ordinary travel, discussion, or an unrelated event in X
ambiguous: a geographic division name without clear physical location
predicate.notes: This is the inverse direction of located_in. The presence of an office does not imply that all of Y is headquartered there; corporate ownership alone is not location.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit organization location, headquarters, office, or base in X; a geographically identified office or division of Y located in X; historical physical organizational location. Excludes: X is a corporate subsidiary or parent rather than a geographic place; national affiliation alone without physical location; ordinary travel, discussion, or an unrelated event in X. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: place versus institution metonymy unresolved; a geographic division name without clear physical location; unclear organization or location attachment. This is the inverse direction of located_in. The presence of an office does not imply that all of Y is headquartered there; corporate ownership alone is not location.

rationale: Literal first arguments are mainly New York/San Francisco/Chicago and second arguments advertising organizations: office/unit paths identify a geographic host of an organizational office. Preserve inverse location, not city-as-subsidiary. Genuine subsidiary facts in the minority do not broaden this predicate.
